applied-config-hash-missing.json.reason: a status always states the applied config's hash, null when none

applied-config-hash-shape.json.reason: a config hash is 64 lowercase hex digits

backend-health.json.reason: a backend entry holds in_flight, max_in_flight and deployments only; unknown fields are refused

backend-id-invalid.json.reason: backends are keyed by backend ID

circuit-closed-with-opened-at.json.reason: a closed circuit carries no opened_at

circuit-half-open-without-opened-at.json.reason: a half-open circuit keeps when it opened

circuit-open-without-opened-at.json.reason: an open circuit says when it opened

circuit-unknown.json.reason: a circuit is closed, open or half_open

deployment-model-name-invalid.json.reason: deployments are keyed by the model name on the backend: printable ASCII, no spaces

deployments-missing.json.reason: every backend entry lists its deployments, possibly none

in-flight-map.json.reason: the top-level in_flight map is gone: in-flight counts live under backends

in-flight-missing.json.reason: every backend entry states its in-flight count

instance-254.json.reason: an instance ID is at most 253 characters

max-in-flight-zero.json.reason: a reported cap is at least 1; no cap is an absent max_in_flight

model-name-props-suffix.json.reason: models are keyed by public model name

models-missing.json.reason: models is required, empty before the first config is applied

queued-per-backend.json.reason: queues belong to models, not backends

rejection-code-shape.json.reason: codes are lowercase words joined by hyphens

rejection-codes-duplicate.json.reason: a rejection lists each code once

rejection-codes-empty.json.reason: a rejection names at least one code
